description: NDUB22TA 4-switch synchronous buck-boost converter module, adjustable output 3.3V/4.2V/5V/6V/9V/10V/12V (selectable versions)

ports.label: DC 3-23V
ports.note: buck-boost verdadeiro: regula a saída acima ou abaixo da entrada

ports.label: Output
ports.note: tensão fixa, selecionada na compra (3.3V / 4.2V / 5V / 6V / 9V / 10V / 12V); não ajustável após fabricação

specs.topology: 4-switch buck-boost (true bidirectional: can step up or step down)

output-voltage.note: fixed output voltage, selectable at purchase: 3.3V / 4.2V / 5V / 6V / 9V / 10V / 12V versions available; not adjustable after purchase

output-current.note: maximum 3A output current or 4A input current, whichever is lower

features: true buck-boost: maintains regulated output above or below input voltage

connections.DC 3-23V: input positive and negative (screw terminal or solder pads)
connections.Output: output positive and negative (screw terminal or solder pads)

specs.note: select the output voltage variant at purchase (e.g., 12V version for motor driver supply); the module cannot be adjusted after manufacture
